dct_title_s: Hydrographic Feature Outlines (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Line coverage which displays the outline of a variety of hydrographic features including double and single line rivers, lakes, reservoirs, streams, glaciers, canals and irrigation ditches. Shorelines and coastlines are also included.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, hydrological analysis and associated areas of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on various water features (rivers, reservoirs, lakes, etc.) found in China, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.

Supplemental information: Note: reservoirs (not to scale) are represented as vector line segments from the lower reaches to the upper reaches along the reservoir center line. Springs are represented as a vector line segment indicating the direction of flow.
